result.rationale: Adult with acute ankle inversion injury who could walk four steps immediately and now, reports no malleolar tip/posterior-edge tenderness, no midfoot pain, mild swelling, no wound or numbness; soreness localized to anterior talofibular soft tissue. Ottawa ankle criteria as reported are negative and no emergency features are described, so home PRICE care with advice to seek assessment if pain/swelling worsen, weight bearing becomes impossible, or no improvement is appropriate.
